fact: NGARi's Botswana project (build in progress, completing 2027) is fine-tuning open Setswana models and releasing them openly, on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor donated to and hosted at Botswana University of Agriculture and Natural Resources in Gaborone, with smaller units at the Orange Digital Center and teaching labs.
title: NGARi Botswana — The Setswana AI Commons
